{{Quote|The occasional oil bath, memory wipe, and actuator adjustment makes for a long, happy life for your new droid!|Statement in the New Users Manual|<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>}}
The '''New Users Manual''' was produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. It was packaged with all [[Droid/Legends|droids]] sold by the company, and offered advice on maintenance services to keep the unit running in prime condition.
